reviews.title: Charging subscription for basic features
reviews.text:
Locks apps by default, no way to change or to allow list apps without subscribing. 

You know. 

To a freaking glorified timer. 

Nothing about the app justifies a subscription. It’s brain dead simple with a simple, ugly ui (which is fine! I like it! But let’s not pretend it cost much in the way of development)

reviews.title: Disappointing update ,too many distracting ads !!
reviews.text:
This is supposed to be a focused study app, but now there are full ads right on the front page every time I open it. It completely ruins my focus and defeats the purpose of a productivity app. Please remove them.

Ads on the front page of a dedicated study app make no sense.

reviews.title: PLEASE leave the UI alone!!
reviews.text: I love this app, but it feels like every update makes it worse!! The UI just got updated again and it’s bad, plus everything is misaligned and now it’s even harder to just use the app. The UI is fine as it was. Please just let the people who want to use the old, classic UI keep using it without changing it around!

reviews.title: These random UI changes…
reviews.text:
Please stop with these new updates where u completely change the UI. The new one for the planner version Home Screen is bad.  It’s clunky and messy. I wasn’t even a hater when the planner version came out (I actually liked it better than legacy) but I think you’ve overcomplicated the new features way too much 

…and I hope that new “coming soon” feature isn’t a useless AI thing

reviews.title: very good app
reviews.text: this app is great but can we please bring back the pause feature for when you switch between subjects! also the timeline that you see when you scroll up was very useful

reviews.title: New update
reviews.text:
I preferred this app as it let me pause my timer very quickly without removing the whole session. It helped me understand realistically how much I e done and be more honest about when I’m not fully focusing. I’d do a to do of maths questions but pause the timer temporarily when I was watching a video or finding papers. Now it’s gone and I have to restart the timer fully every single time, it’s so demotivating as I see less time and feel like I can do less in one sitting. 

Please bring it back.

reviews.title: I love the app and the concept
reviews.text: I’ve tried many study apps finally I’ve found one that is convenient to use and actually motivates me to study. It has all the element I love anime and the prospect of your character leveling up quite simply as you study, community I love that I can join and speak to fellow lawyers or law students studying and it’s a great time tracker with useful insights. I do wish there was more of a range of characters for example there are no black avatars they really need to include more variety

reviews.title: 오류가 너무 심합니다.
reviews.text: 진짜 리뷰 같은 거 처음 쓰는 거 같은데, 오류가 화날 정도로 많이 나요. 가장 큰 건 오늘 공부했던 시간이 다음날로 넘어가거나, 전날로 되돌아가 기록이 된다는 거예요. 이거때문에 미치겠습니다. 전엔 이정도로 심하진 않았는데 요새 이러네요. 빠른 시일 안에 고쳐지길 바랍니다.
